title: Joan
blurb: Widowed, worried about care. She read out her Social Security number, which must never reach Claude.
notes:
Joan Pederson - check-in 10/30
Joan, 74, widowed (Arne passed in 2021). Health good, plays bridge 3x a week. Her mom needed 5 years of memory care so that's top of mind - biggest worry is paying for care.
She brought her Social Security card and started reading the number off it: 512-44-8790. Told her we don't need it.

Income: teachers' pension $3,800/mo with a COLA. Her own SS is $1,400/mo, started at 67. (Arne's benefit was about $2,600 - she should be getting the larger of the two, need to double check with SSA what she's actually receiving.)
IRA $410k, Roth $35k, brokerage $220k (basis maybe $150k), cash $45k.
House is worth around $340k. Not planning to move.

Spends about $5,200/mo. Church mission trips, $5k/yr for maybe 8 more years. Gives family about $10k a year and also gives to church - she writes checks, around $4,000 a year. Wants to leave $150k to the grandkids.
Mod. conservative mix.
Doesn't think she has long-term care insurance. "Arne looked into it once."
Asked if there's a smarter way to do her church giving.
She'd cut back some in a bad year if she had to.
